image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a common iguana (Iguana iguana). The image focuses on the head, neck, and upper shoulder region. Visible features include the prominent dorsal crest spines, the large subtympanic shield (circular scale) below the ear, textured granular scales on the skin, and a portion of the green body transitioning to greyish head scales. There is faint, gibberish text in the top-left corner.
